instruction: An action photograph with a high-angle full shot shows a bright white indoor studio. In the foreground, the cheerleader with long dark hair (R14) in a white t-shirt and white skirt leans forward and to the right, extending her orange pom-poms downward with heavy motion blur. Behind her, the cheerleader with curly brown hair (R11) in a matching outfit mirrors the pose, leaning and extending her pom-poms to the right. The two perform a synchronized movement against a clean white background with vertical light stands. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the vibrant orange of the pom-poms.
